skirmish.module.camera_comfort.name: Camera comfort
skirmish.module.camera_comfort.descripti: Vanilla camera options in one place: view bobbing, damage tilt, FOV and distortion effects, lightning flashes. While the module is on it changes these game options; your previous values come back when it is turned off.
skirmish.module.camera_comfort.setting.d: Vanilla "Damage Tilt": how much the camera shakes when hit
skirmish.module.camera_comfort.setting.f: Vanilla "FOV Effects": view changes from sprinting, speed and slowness
skirmish.module.camera_comfort.setting.h: Vanilla option: the sky doesn't flash on lightning (bolts stay visible)
skirmish.module.low_fire.name: Low fire
skirmish.module.low_fire.description: Lower, fainter fire on screen, like a "low fire" resource pack. You can still see that you are burning.
skirmish.module.low_fire.setting.lower_b: How far below vanilla the flames sit
skirmish.module.low_fire.setting.opacity: How dense the flames are (100% is vanilla)
skirmish.module.low_fire.setting.hide_wh: Don't draw the fire overlay while the Fire Resistance effect is active
